5 Dependencies to Other Modules
The [20, EXP Layered Software Architecture] shows an overview of the neighboring
modules of the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager.
The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager module (J1939Dcm) has
direct interfaces and/or configuration dependencies towards the Diagnostic
Event Manager (DEM), the PDU Router (PduR), the J1939 Request Manager
(J1939Rm), the Basic Software Mode Manager (BswM), the ECU State Man-
ager (EcuM), and the Default Error Tracer (DET), and also to application soft-
ware components (SW-Cs) via the AUTOSAR Runtime Environment (RTE and
to Complex Drivers (CDD). Besides these, there are also indirect dependencies
towards the Communication Manager (ComM), the J1939 Transport Layer (
J1939Tp), and the CAN Interface (CanIf). See also Figure 5.1.
The
J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager
module
includes
header
files of the Diagnostic Event Manager, the PDU Router, the Basic Soft-
ware Mode Manager, the J1939 Request Manager, and the Default Error
Tracer.
